title: My Money World: Rupee Basics
learningGoals: Identify Indian Rupee notes and coins
Perform basic addition of money values

teachingScript.teacherLine: Welcome to Level 1! Today we learn about the Rupee (₹). Before money, people swapped things — like a toy for an apple. Now, we use magic tokens called Rupees!

data.title: The Magic Token: ₹
points: Today: The Rupee (INR) is our official currency
Every note has Mahatma Gandhi on it!

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's count! If you have two ₹10 notes and one ₹20 note, how much total money do you have?

Money doesn't just appear — we earn it by doing valuable work! In MoneyMind, your parents can set 'Rewards' for real-world chores. When you finish a task (like cleaning your desk), you earn virtual coins to spend in our simulators!
Every week, you might get pocket money. Let's see how to manage it. If you want a new Sketchbook for ₹100, how much do you need to save each week?

questionPool.questionText: What is the symbol of the Indian Rupee?
questionPool.hint: It looks like the Hindi 'Ra' with an extra line.
